theorem.current_information_closure: THE CELL IS CLOSED WITH ZERO NEW TARGET INFORMATION IFF EVERY CURRENT INFORMATION CELL C IN PI HAS NONEMPTY COVER(C).
theorem.robust_special_case: IF SOME p IN P DOMINATES EVERY mu IN K THEN NO TARGET DISCRIMINATOR IS REQUIRED.
theorem.discriminator_case: IF SOME CURRENT CELL C HAS EMPTY COVER(C) BUT THERE EXISTS AN ADMISSIBLE PRECOMMITMENT DISCRIMINATOR THAT REFINES C INTO SUBCELLS C_j WITH NONEMPTY COVER(C_j) FOR EVERY j, THEN THE RESIDUAL IS INFORMATION/DISCRIMINATION RATHER THAN A PROVED CAPABILITY GAP.
theorem.singleton_capability_region: M={mu IN K : FOR_ALL p IN P NOT D(p,mu)}. MEMBERS OF M CANNOT BE CLOSED BY ANY CURRENT BRAIN_POLICY EVEN GIVEN EXACT TARGET_LAW IDENTITY.
theorem.occupancy_rule: M NONEMPTY DOES NOT BY ITSELF PROVE THE ACTUAL OPUS55 LAW IS A CAPABILITY FAILURE; TERMINAL CLOSURE MAY EITHER ADD A BRAIN POLICY THAT DOMINATES M OR SOUNDLY EXCLUDE ACTUAL TARGET OCCUPANCY OF M.
theorem.proved_capability_gap: A REAL CURRENT CAPABILITY GAP IS ESTABLISHED ONLY WHEN THE ACTUAL TARGET LAW OR A SOUNDLY UNAVOIDABLE TARGET CLASS IS BOUND INSIDE M.
theorem.invention_rule: WHEN A SOUND LOAD_BEARING TARGET CLASS IS IN M, MISSION LOCK V8 AUTHORIZES REUSE EXTRACTION INVENTION OR ARCHITECTURE REDESIGN AS PEER ROUTES; CHOOSE THE FASTEST SOUND ZERO_SPEND ROUTE THAT REMOVES THAT REGION FROM M.
theorem.stopping_rule: STOP TARGET INFORMATION ACQUISITION AS SOON AS EVERY CURRENT INFORMATION CELL HAS A COMMON ADEQUATE OWNED POLICY; STOP CAPABILITY SEARCH AS SOON AS M IS EMPTY OR ACTUAL TARGET OCCUPANCY OF M IS SOUNDLY EXCLUDED.

scheduler: FOR_EACH UNRESOLVED ABC CELL FIRST COMPUTE OR OVERAPPROXIMATE K AND THE DOMINANCE EDGES FOR CURRENT OWNED POLICIES.
ATTEMPT ROBUST COMMON COVER BEFORE ANY TARGET QUERY.
IF COMMON COVER FAILS SEARCH THE CHEAPEST ADMISSIBLE DISCRIMINATOR THAT PRODUCES ONLY CELLS WITH COMMON COVER.
COMPUTE M ONLY AFTER POSITIVE ADEQUACY SEARCH OVER CURRENT POLICIES IS SATURATED ENOUGH FOR THE CLAIM BEING MADE; FAILURE TO FIND A POLICY IS NOT PROOF OF M MEMBERSHIP.
FOR A SOUNDLY ESTABLISHED M REGION RACE TWO ROUTES: DOMINATE R BY REUSE/EXTRACTION/INVENTION OR EXCLUDE OPUS OCCUPANCY OF R BY MINIMUM TARGET INFORMATION/STRUCTURE.
DO NOT RUN A BROAD BENCHMARK WHEN A ONE_BIT OR ONE_PROPERTY DISCRIMINATOR EXCLUDES THE SAME M REGION.
DO NOT INVENT WHEN THE ONLY RESIDUAL IS UNKNOWN TARGET OCCUPANCY AND EXCLUSION IS CHEAPER.
DO NOT WAIT FOR TARGET INFORMATION WHEN A TOP_ELEMENT OR NEW OWNED POLICY CAN DOMINATE THE WHOLE UNCERTAINTY CELL FASTER.
